literal: Disease-absence, wealth, yield, happiness, security: ornament they-say to-a-country these five.
translation: They say these five are the ornaments of a country: freedom from disease, wealth, rich harvests, happiness, and security.
modern: நோயின்மை, செல்வம், விளைச்சல், மகிழ்ச்சி, பாதுகாப்பு ஆகிய இந்த ஐந்தும் ஒரு நாட்டிற்கு அழகு என்று கூறுவார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet lists the five essential qualities that adorn a prosperous country. 'பிணியின்மை' (absence of disease) ensures a healthy population, while 'செல்வம்' (wealth) and 'விளைவு' (agricultural yield) provide economic stability. 'இன்பம்' (happiness) reflects the well-being of the people, and 'ஏமம்' (security) guarantees their safety. Together, these five elements are described as the true 'அணி' (ornaments) of a nation, making it beautiful and complete.
